messages:
sam: Heads-up — I'm putting together a compact Grafana canvas for GPU node health that combines GPU util, GPU mem pressure, core temp, PCIe bandwidth, and host network IO. Want to capture both short bursts and sustained load so SRE + infra can triage faster.

alexa: +1. Can we also surface NVLink usage and PCIe retransmits? We had a weird outage where network + nvlink saturation correlated with evictions.

raj: prefer separate small panels for short-window signals (1m/5m) and longer SLO rollups (1h) — otherwise the short spikes get lost. Also add a derived "thermal headroom" metric (max safe - current temp).

marta: For layout: top row = util / mem / mem-alloc-fail-rate, mid = temps + headroom + fan RPM, bottom = PCIe/NVLink + eth rx/tx + pci-errors. Add an annotations lane for deploys and cluster scaling events.

sam: Agreed. Thinking queries:
```promql
# per-GPU mem usage pct
100 * (nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes{job="dc-gpu"} / nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes{job="dc-gpu"})
# PCIe bandwidth (bytes/s)
rate(pcie_device_tx_bytes_total[1m]) + rate(pcie_device_rx_bytes_total[1m])
```

alexa: Nice. For SLOs we should compute node-level 95p util over 1h and alert if >90% and memory >85% for 10m. Keep alerts as multi-condition so noisy infra doesn't page.

raj: Example alert rule idea (pseudocode):
```yaml
- alert: GPUNodeCapacityPressure
  expr: |
    (avg_over_time(gpu_utilization_pct[1h]) > 90 and avg_over_time(gpu_memory_pct[10m]) > 85)
  for: 10m
  labels: {severity: "page"}
  annotations: {summary: "GPU node capacity pressure"}
```

marta: Can we also add a cheaper rollup view for cost ops: per-tenant GPU-hours and avg-utilization to justify consolidation? Might help with capacity planning.

sam: Yes — add a "cost" dashboard tab with queries driven by allocation tags. We should also include region filters because eu-west has limited spare slots and different thermal baselines.

alexa: Small nit: use histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(cuda_kernel_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) for tail latency of kernels where applicable. Shows if long-running kernels coincide with temp spikes.

ops-bot: Reminder: nightly job "gpu-metrics-backfill" will re-ingest 6h of metrics starting 02:00 UTC tomorrow. Expect annotation noise. (reaction :bell:)

sam: Good call. I'll add an "ingest job" annotation and exclude that window from SLO reporting.

marta: Who's owning the PR for the panels? I can prototype the JSON and drop a diffs link in #grafana-dashboards.

sam: Assign to marta for panel JSON. raj can review queries + alerts. alexa will validate NVLink PCIe metrics. I'll handle rollout and dashboard ACLs. Target: PR by EOD Thu.

alexa: I'll run the NVLink scrape sanity checks against staging after the PR lands.

raj: Will add playback recordings for a couple nodes so we can demo spike vs sustained scenarios in the runbook.

marta: OK I'll upload a draft JSON and list of queries. Thanks all.

sam: Thanks team — keeping this compact will make on-call triage faster.
